errors.text_span: “筜生活工作笢”和“筜生理活动笢”两类动词
errors.evidence: The description invents these two categories to describe the chart's purpose and structure. The actual charts are about "支配动词" (dominant verbs) in (a) and "承受动词" (patient verbs) in (b), as stated in the sub-captions.

errors.text_span: “新闻”、“两性文库”、“网络小说”和“语料”四个类别
errors.evidence: The description incorrectly identifies two of the four categories on the horizontal axis. The correct labels are "新闻" (News), "传统文学" (Traditional Literature), "网络小说" (Web Fiction), and "微博" (Weibo). The description uses "两性文库" instead of "传统文学" and "语料" instead of "微博".
The description fails to mention the sub-categories "女性" (female) and "男性" (male) under each main category on the horizontal axis. This is a critical structural component of the charts.
The description incorrectly states that the unit of the vertical axis is percentage (%). The axis is labeled "频次" (Frequency) and the scale represents absolute counts, not percentages.
The major tick marks on the vertical axis are at intervals of 1000 (0, 1000, 2000, ...), not 500.

errors.text_span: 在图 (a) 中，每个语体类别都包含两根堆叠的柱，分别代表“筜生活工作笢”和“筜生理活动笢”这两种类别
errors.evidence: This statement misrepresents the chart's structure. Each corpus type has bars for female and male subjects, and each bar is a single stack representing multiple semantic sub-domains from the legend, not two separate bars for two hallucinated categories.

errors.text_span: 在“新闻”语体中，“筜生活工作笢”柱的高度约为 4700%，而“筜生理活动笢”则由不同颜色组成的高度总和约为 570%。
errors.evidence: The numerical values and units are completely wrong. For chart (a) under "新闻", the "女性" bar has a total height of 409. The description provides entirely fabricated values ("4700%", "570%") that do not correspond to anything in the figure.

errors.text_span: 类似地，“新闻”语体中，“筜生活工作笢”柱的高度约为 410%，而“筜生理活动笢”的总高度约为 500%。
errors.evidence: The numerical values and units for chart (b) are also incorrect. In chart (b) under "新闻", the bars have total heights of 23 (female) and 479 (male). The reported values ("410%", "500%") are fabricated.

errors.text_span: 分组排列使我们可以根据语体类别对不同语义域的分布进行比较。
errors.evidence: The prompt explicitly asks to avoid comparisons unless they are explicitly labeled in the chart. This sentence makes an interpretive statement about the purpose of the grouping.
